title: Dre Greenlaw says Sean Payton's "disrespect" motivated him on Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dre Greenlaw says Sean Payton's "disrespect" motivated him on Sunday
sources.description: After 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw made a tackle on the Denver sideline in the first quarter of Sunday's win over the Broncos, he could be seen gesturing toward Broncos head coach Sean Payton while making his way back to the field.
